title: Agent 技能与记忆层集中爆发
opening: 今天榜单几乎被 coding agent 的周边设施占满：记忆持久化、技能框架、多 agent 编排、控制面板各占一块。最值得看的是 claude-mem 和 superpowers——前者试图解决 agent 跨会话失忆，后者把开发方法论拆成可组合的技能包，两者都在给 agent 补“长期工作”的底子。

projects.name: mattpocock/skills
projects.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Skills For Real Engineers My agent skills that I use every day to do real engineering - not vibe coding. Developing real applications is hard. Approaches like GSD, BMAD, and Spec-Kit try to help by owning the process. But while doing so, they take away your control and make bugs in the process hard to resolve. These skills are designed to be small, easy to adapt, and composable. They work with any model. They're based on decades of engineering experience. Hack around with them. Make them your own. Enjoy. If you want to keep up with changes to these skills, and any new ones I create, you can join ~60,000 other devs on my newsletter: Sign Up To The Newsletter Installation (30-second setup) A plugin updates itself. skills.sh copies editable files into your project, and you update them by hand. Pick one per agent, because installing both gives you every skill twice. 1. Get the skills Claude Code Updates itself by default. Codex Updates itself at startup. GitHub Copilot (CLI and VS Code) Then, once, add to `~/.copilot/settings.json`: In VS Code, run **Chat: Install Plugin From Source** and enter `https://github.com/mattpocock/skills`. It updates daily. Gemini CLI (manual updates) Re-run

projects.name: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios
projects.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Claude Code Game Studios Turn a single Claude Code session into a full game development studio. 49 agents. 74 skills. One coordinated AI team. Why This Exists Building a game solo with AI is powerful — but a single chat session has no structure. No one stops you from hardcoding magic numbers, skipping design docs, or writing spaghetti code. There's no QA pass, no design review, no one asking "does this actually fit the game's vision?" **Claude Code Game Studios** solves this by giving your AI session the structure of a real studio. Instead of one general-purpose assistant, you get 49 specialized agents organized into a studio hierarchy — directors who guard the vision, department leads who own their domains, and specialists who do the hands-on work. Each agent has defined responsibilities, escalation paths, and quality gates. The result: you still make every decision, but now you have a team that asks the right questions, catches mistakes early, and keeps your project organized from first brainstorm to launch. Table of Contents - What's Included - Studio Hierarchy - Slash Commands - Does it produce games, or documents? - Getting Started - Configuration - Upgrading - Project Structu
projects.summary: 把单个 Claude Code 会话改造成 49 个 agent 的游戏工作室，带层级、升级路径和质量门禁。
projects.problem: 用工作室组织结构约束 AI 开发游戏：总监守愿景、部门主管管领域、专员干活，试图拦住硬编码魔数和跳过设计文档。实际效果取决于 agent 间协调开销，小项目可能觉得流程过重。

projects.name: pingdotgg/t3code
projects.readmeExcerpt: T3 Code T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app (iOS, Android), web app and Electron-based desktop app. Works with your subscriptions on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, and fx. If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them. "Wait, what are you selling me?" Nothing. We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents. We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar. We wanted something performant, remote-ready, and truly open. If we ever go the wrong direction, we want you to have everything you need to fork and build the editor that you want. projects.readmeExcerpt: Impeccable The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with `polish` and `bolder`, review with `critique` and `audit`, and catch AI slop before it ships. From your project root: Reload your coding tool, then run `/impeccable init` in your agent (`$impeccable init` on Codex). Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Replit Agent, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, Kiro, Trae, Rovo Dev, Qoder, Mistral Vibe, Pi, Hermes Agent, DeepSeek Harness, and Veto. Full docs live at impeccable.style/docs. | Without Impeccable | With Impeccable | Same model (Fable 5.1), same brief: a fourteen-room family guesthouse on the Ligurian coast. projects.name: obra/superpowers
projects.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Superpowers Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them. Table of Contents - How it works - Commercial Services - Getting Started - Claude Code - Antigravity - Codex App - Codex CLI - Cursor - Devin CLI - Factory Droid - Gemini CLI - GitHub Copilot CLI - Grok Build CLI - Kimi Code - OpenCode - Pi - Qwen Code - Hermes Agent - Muse - The Basic Workflow - When Something Goes Wrong - Community - What's Inside - Philosophy - Contributing - Updating - License - Visual companion telemetry How it works It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it *doesn't* just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do. Once it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest. After you've signed off on the design, your agent puts together an implementation plan that's clear enough for an enthusiastic junior engineer with poor taste, no judgement, no project context, and an aver
projects.summary: 一套完整的 agent 开发方法论：先逼出 spec，再分块确认设计，最后生成连“没品味的初级工程师”都能执行的计划。
projects.problem: 核心是不让 agent 一上来就写代码，而是退一步问清目标。技能可组合，覆盖从头脑风暴到 SDLC 的流程。限制是流程本身需要用户持续参与确认，想全自动的人会觉得啰嗦。

closing: 今天的关键词不是新模型，而是给 agent 补基础设施：记忆、技能、编排、控制面。热闹之下，真正稀缺的是像 impeccable 那样敢对 AI 默认审美说不，以及像 ziwei-doushu 那样把局限写进文档的诚实。
